description: What a standard (non-admin) Windows user can carry from one PC to another. Each entry is a set of files or HKCU registry keys. Tokens: %APPDATA% %LOCALAPPDATA% %USERPROFILE% %DOCUMENTS% %DESKTOP%. An entry whose paths/keys do not exist on the source machine is skipped silently. secret=true entries are only exported with -IncludeSecrets and are encrypted when a password is given. appCheck: list of indicators that the owning program is installed (uninstall:<regex on display name>, cmd:<exe on PATH>, appx:<package name>, a registry key, or a path); when none matches, Import-Profile defers the entry until a later run finds the program. Files whose staged path exceeds 245 characters are skipped and listed (zip libraries cannot read them). dynamic: 'bruno-collections' (paths read from Bruno's config) or 'hkcu-vendors' (HKCU\Software vendor keys found at export time); defaultOff: unticked by default in the wizard.

categories.office: Microsoft Office user settings, templates, signatures, dictionaries, macros, add-ins
categories.browser: Browser profiles (bookmarks, extensions, history). Saved passwords/cookies do NOT travel in Chrome/Edge (DPAPI-bound) - sign in to sync
categories.secrets: Keys, tokens and credential stores - opt-in, encrypted

entries.notes: Bookmarks, extensions, history, open tabs, site settings. Site data (IndexedDB/WebStorage - web-app caches like YouTube/Teams) is excluded; sites rebuild it.

entries.app: Notepad (Windows 11) - open and unsaved tabs, settings
entries.summary: Notepad tabs that were still open, including unsaved text, plus Notepad settings.
entries.notes: TabState holds every open tab, saved or not; Settings holds font, wrap and theme. Notepad must be CLOSED on both machines (it rewrites TabState while running and on the new PC it would overwrite the restored tabs).

entries.summary: AutoRecover copies of documents that were open and not saved (Word .asd, Excel, PowerPoint) and the Unsaved Files folder.
entries.notes: Office writes AutoRecover files every 10 minutes while a document is open and keeps closed-without-saving copies for four days in UnsavedFiles. Save your work first; this is a safety net, not a replacement. After the restore, Office offers them under File > Info > Manage Document > Recover Unsaved Documents.

entries.summary: Items you pinned in the clipboard history (Win+V). The unpinned history is memory-only and cannot be carried.
entries.notes: Only pinned clipboard items are stored on disk.

entries.summary: Your saved Bruno requests and environments: the collection folders Bruno knows about, wherever you keep them.
entries.notes: Folders are read from Bruno's preferences.json (default location) and from its workspace/UI state files; each folder that holds a bruno.json is taken. Restored to the same path (adjusted if the username differs). Environments with secrets travel as Bruno stores them.

entries.app: VS Code extensions (the installed files, not just the list)
entries.summary: The extension files themselves. Usually not needed - the list is captured and extensions are reinstalled from the Marketplace. Tick this when the Marketplace is blocked at work. Can be large.
entries.notes: Copies %USERPROFILE%\.vscode\extensions including its extensions.json manifest (paths inside are rewritten when the username differs). Same architecture on both PCs is assumed (win32-x64). Restored before the Marketplace step, which then finds everything present.

entries.app: Settings of other programs kept in the registry
entries.summary: HKCU\Software keys of programs the kit has no entry for (window layouts, recent files, options). Each key is restored only once its program is installed here.
entries.notes: Every vendor key under HKCU\Software except Windows/Microsoft, hardware vendors, browsers (covered as files), corporate agents and the keys other catalog entries already cover. Keys over 5 MB are skipped. On restore a key is imported when a program whose name or publisher matches the key name is installed; the rest wait for the next run (or -RestoreEvenIfMissing).

entries.app: MobaXterm sessions, settings and home folder
entries.summary: Saved sessions, macros, settings, SSH host keys (MobaXterm.ini) and the Linux-style home folder (.ssh keys, .bashrc). The big Cygwin root (slash) is left out.
entries.notes: Installer edition keeps MobaXterm.ini in %APPDATA%\MobaXterm (older versions under Documents\MobaXterm); the portable edition keeps it next to its exe - that one is found by the data-folder discovery or can be added with 'Add a folder'. Stored passwords live in the registry (entry tools-mobaxterm-reg). MobaXterm must be CLOSED on both machines: it rewrites the ini on exit.

entries.summary: Credentials and passwords MobaXterm saved (encrypted). They open on the new PC only if you had set a master password in MobaXterm; otherwise re-enter them once.
entries.notes: HKCU\Software\Mobatek\MobaXterm: C = credentials, P = passwords, M = master password settings. Without a master password MobaXterm derives the key from the Windows account, so the copied values cannot be decrypted on another PC and have to be typed again (the session list itself is in the ini and works).

entries.summary: Tabby profiles, hotkeys and the plugin list.
